context: Hiroshi and Kenji set year-end goals.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 健次、年末の目標、決めるぞ。
lines.en: Kenji — we're setting your year-end target today.
lines.style: Direct, measured opening. Firm but not harsh. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to. Slight pause after the name for weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Not servile. A warm acceptance — this is someone he works well with. Slight lean-in with the attention.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Twenty percent increase in annual sales.
lines.style: Numbers land clearly. No softening. The firmness of someone stating fact, not asking for permission. Each phrase distinct.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: That's a high target, isn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Not questioning the decision, but acknowledging the weight of it. Warm respect underneath — he's taking it seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Philosophical but not abstract. A principle stated quietly, with conviction. The kind of thing said once and meant to stay.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: チーム、一緒に、頑張ります。
lines.en: I'll work hard with the team to make it happen.
lines.style: Sincere commitment. Not performance — this is someone meaning what he says. Slight firmness on 'team,' showing he understands this isn't solo work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Direct and clear, but not accusatory. A moment of eye-contact weight. The words are a trust, not a burden.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、全力で、取り組みます。
lines.en: Yes — I'll tackle it with everything I have.
lines.style: Immediate and earnest. No hesitation. The 'yes' is a commitment. Pace stays steady, showing calm resolve.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Break it down into stages and move forward.
lines.style: Instructional but not condescending. Offering structure. The tone of someone who has thought this through and is sharing the path forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 了解です、計画、立てます。
lines.style: Efficient acknowledgment. No wasted words. Shows he's already thinking ahead. Slight note of confidence beneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: チームと、共有、忘れるな。
lines.en: Share it with the team. Don't keep it to yourself.
lines.style: Firm reminder. Not a warning — a principle. Weight on 'share' and 'team.' The kind of thing said because it matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、皆と、一緒に、進めます。
lines.en: Yes — I'll move forward with everyone together.
lines.style: Warm assurance. He's heard what matters and is affirming it. No performance, just honest agreement. Slightly slower on 'together' for emphasis.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Closing warmth layered under firmness. Not 'we'll see how it goes' — this is trust stated plainly. A moment of human regard beneath the role.
